one_line: Say the parent's problem over the real action, then show uses in 1 to 2 s cuts.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 static wide shot in a bright living room: a mother crouches by foam steps while a baby pulls up on them. Voiceover (transcript): "אם גם הילד שלכן הגיע לשלב שהוא פשוט מטפס על כל דבר בבית". No text.
q1_hook.why: The spoken line names a stage parents know, a child who climbs everything, while a baby climbs on screen (H1, K6). The solution follows at 0:03 (H2). With no text and faces in profile, a muted viewer gets only the picture (H6, T3).

beats.what: Mother crouches by foam steps; baby pulls up holding her hands; "מטפס על כל דבר בבית" (transcript)
beats.why: Problem said and shown at once

beats.what: Baby on top of the steps; mother helps him down the ramp; "מצאתי לכם את הפתרון המושלם" (transcript)
Mother lifts a cube; close-up of ramp and pouf; baby's face looks up through the round hole
beats.why: A cute close-up reward after the demo

beats.what: Pieces rearranged, baby crawls around the cube, mother claps; "כל פעם מסדרים אותו אחרת" (transcript)
beats.why: Shows the rearranging claim as it is said

beats.what: Baby sits in the cube, a small dog walks by; mother wipes a pouf; "מתנקה בקלות" (transcript)
beats.why: Answers the cleaning doubt in one shot

beats.what: Mother laughs and claps, baby in the cube; voice ends near 0:15

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption only: "תגיבי ״לינק״ ואני שולחת לך" with a 12% discount for followers. Nothing in the video asks for a comment, save or share.
q2_flow.why: A problem, a turn at 0:03 and a warm ending make a short arc (K2), and a new action every 1 to 3 s keeps the middle moving with facts said as they are shown (R3). At 16 s, with a 1.6 s tail, there is no dead air (R1, R2). The mother's laughter is the joy peak (K1).

q3_cta.what: None in the video: no text and no spoken ask. Caption: "סידרתי לכן 12% הנחה על כל האתר כולל כפל מבצעים / תגיבי ״לינק״ ואני שולחת לך".
q3_cta.why: A generic comment word that delivers a link and a discount is a legitimate funnel (C3) and one action (C1), but it is neither said nor shown in the video (C6). Anyone who does not open the caption sees no offer. The offer is in the first caption line.

q4_shown.what: The foam set in use from 0:00: baby on the steps, down the ramp 0:02-0:05, in the cube's hole 0:07, crawling round rearranged pieces 0:08-0:11, a wipe of a pouf 0:12-0:14, the mother laughing. No price, no logo on the product.
q4_shown.why: The product is in use from the first frame (S1), with a baby's face and a mother's joy as the centre (K8). "The most useful thing I put in the living room" (transcript) is first-person (S6). Stability is said but not shown, only cleaning is (C7). No disclosure words appear (S7).

q5_edit.what: 10 shots in 16.7 s, about 1.7 s each: the first 5.3 s is one static shot, then 9 quick cuts to 12.2 s, then one static 4.5 s shot. Voiceover until about 0:15. No text, no speed changes. Ends on the mother laughing.
q5_edit.why: Movement from frame one (E1) and cuts inside the same scene keep a brisk but clear pace (E2). All meaning rides on the voice with nothing on screen, so it fails muted (E4). It ends within 2 s of the last line (E8).

q6_topic.what: A foam play set (steps, slide, cube, poufs) as the answer to a baby who climbs everything, with a 12% discount for followers.
q6_topic.why: The climbing stage is a real concern for parents of babies (K6), though "הפתרון המושלם" is hype wording. Parents can send it to a friend whose baby climbs (R5). The mother's laughter gives a warm, high-energy feeling (K1).

q7_filmed.what: A propped static phone at eye level in a bright, neutral-toned living room with sheer curtains and soft window light; a mother in a white top, a baby on a carpet. Two close-ups for the ramp and the hole.
q7_filmed.why: Sharp, soft-lit and vertical (F1, F7), but the styled neutral room reads more as a brand shoot than a home clip (H8). Close-ups fill the frame with the pieces (F4). The baby is cut by the frame edge at 0:05 and the mother at 0:14 (F2).

q8_text.on_screen: None in any frame (one per second): no subtitles, headline, labels or CTA text, and no logo or brand name visible on the product.
q8_text.caption: "סידרתי לכן 12% הנחה על כל האתר כולל כפל מבצעים". Two lines, about 17 words: the offer, then "תגיבי ״לינק״ ואני שולחת לך". No hashtags, no brand tag, no disclosure words.
q8_text.why: With no text, the message is sound only and a muted viewer gets nothing (T1, T3). The first caption line carries the offer, but there are no product keywords or hashtags (T7) and no disclosure words (T8).

weak_points: No text or subtitles at all; the offer and comment word only in the caption; the brand never visible or tagged; no disclosure words; stability claims said but not shown; the styled set reads as a brand shoot.
lumebook_takeaway: Film the problem in action in one wide 5 s shot, then close cuts of hands and pages; add subtitles and put the comment word on screen.
not_verified: Whether the voice is the creator's; the machine transcript garbles the brand name and the last words. Music is not evident. Any text between the 1 s samples. The baby's age (a baby of about 8 to 12 months is an estimate). Whether the post was paid beyond the coauthor listing. Correction to src/coded: cta_type lists "code", but there is no code word, only a 12% discount via the DM link. Lead edit 18 Oct: resolution remarks removed, because the downloaded copy can be smaller than what was posted.
